title: OpenDraco: A Platform for Engineering and Experimenting with Configurable Multi-Agent Architectures for Software Engineering
title_zh: OpenDraco：一个用于构建和实验软件工程可配置多智能体架构的平台

paragraphs.en: Experimenting with LLM-based multi-agent systems (MAS) involves an iterative cycle of modeling configurations, executing and evaluating them, comparing results, and refining system designs. Existing approaches provide limited end-to-end support for this experimentation lifecycle. We present OpenDraco , an open-source platform that integrates these activities into a single workflow. OpenDraco represents agents, prompts, tools, models, parameters, and communication topology in exportable, versioned JSON specifications, translated into executable LangGraph workflows supporting different interaction structures. Users can modify and re-evaluate configurations using local or cloud-based LLMs. We instantiate OpenDraco for automated program repair (APR) and evaluate a sequential baseline and seven reconstructed configurations on synthetic and real-world SWE-bench Lite issues. The results reveal substantial cost differences among configurations with similar repair outcomes, while the baseline resolves 12 of 77 SWE-bench issues using open-source LLMs. Additional proof-of-concept tasks illustrate applicability beyond APR. OpenDraco supports iterative experimentation with heterogeneous MAS configurations, enabling researchers to examine their outcomes and costs within a common environment. Demonstration video: https://youtu.be/278sOR4lBEk .
paragraphs.zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）实验涉及一个迭代循环：对配置建模、执行与评估配置、比较结果，并改进系统设计。 现有方法对这一实验生命周期的端到端支持十分有限。 我们提出了 OpenDraco，这是一个开源平台，将这些活动整合到单一工作流中。 OpenDraco 将智能体、提示词、工具、模型、参数和通信拓扑表示为可导出、带版本的 JSON 规范，并将其转换为支持不同交互结构的可执行 LangGraph 工作流。 用户可以使用本地或云端的大语言模型修改并重新评估配置。 我们将 OpenDraco 实例化用于自动化程序修复（APR），并在合成及真实世界的 SWE-bench Lite 问题上评估了一个顺序基线以及七个重建的配置。 结果显示，修复效果相近的配置之间存在巨大的成本差异，而基线在使用开源大语言模型的情况下解决了 77 个 SWE-bench 问题中的 12 个。 额外的概念验证任务展示了其超越 APR 的适用性。 OpenDraco 支持对异构 MAS 配置进行迭代实验，使研究人员能够在统一环境中考察其结果与成本。 演示视频：https://youtu.be/278sOR4lBEk 。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used in agentic solutions for Software Engineering (SE) tasks, including automated program repair (APR) [ 1 , 2 ] . Multi-agent systems (MAS) address these tasks by coordinating specialized agents, such as bug localizers, patch generators, and validators [ 3 , 4 ] . How these agents communicate is an important design choice: different topologies determine how information flows between agents and may affect both task outcomes and computational cost [ 5 , 6 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被用于软件工程（SE）任务的智能体解决方案中，包括自动化程序修复（APR）[ 1 , 2 ] 。 多智能体系统（MAS）通过协调专门的智能体（如缺陷定位器、补丁生成器和验证器）来解决这些任务[ 3 , 4 ] 。 这些智能体之间如何通信是一个重要的设计选择：不同的拓扑结构决定了信息如何在智能体之间流动，并可能同时影响任务结果和计算成本[ 5 , 6 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Developing a MAS is only part of the challenge. Researchers investigating alternative architectures also need to adjust configurations, run them on comparable tasks, evaluate their outputs, and track the results. Existing frameworks and visual development environments simplify the construction and execution of agent workflows. However, comparing MAS configurations for SE tasks requires managing benchmark instances and evaluation results. Without an integrated workflow, such experiments become harder to organize and reproduce [ 7 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 开发多智能体系统（MAS）只是挑战的一部分。 研究其他架构的研究人员还需要调整配置，在可比较的任务上运行它们，评估其输出，并跟踪结果。 现有的框架和可视化开发环境简化了智能体工作流的构建与执行。 然而，比较用于软件工程（SE）任务的多智能体系统配置需要管理基准实例和评估结果。 缺乏集成的工作流，此类实验将更难组织和复现 [ 7 ] 。

paragraphs.en: We present OpenDraco , an open-source platform designed to support this experimentation process. OpenDraco represents agents as nodes and their communication topology as edges, while keeping prompts, tools, models, and parameters configurable. Each system is captured in an exportable, versioned JSON specification that is translated into an executable LangGraph workflow 1 1 1 https://www.langchain.com/langgraph .Researchers can reuse agent definitions, modify their communication structure, and execute alternative configurations using local or cloud-based agents. By storing specifications and results, OpenDraco enables researchers and practitioners to reproduce experiments, compare configurations, and iteratively refine MASs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 OpenDraco，一个旨在支持这一实验过程的开源平台。 OpenDraco 将智能体表示为节点，将其通信拓扑表示为边，同时保持提示、工具、模型和参数均可配置。 每个系统都以可导出、带版本控制的 JSON 规范来描述，该规范被转换为可执行的 LangGraph 工作流 1 1 1 https://www.langchain.com/langgraph 。研究人员可以复用智能体定义、修改其通信结构，并使用本地或云端智能体执行替代配置。 通过存储规范和结果，OpenDraco 使研究人员和从业者能够复现实验、比较不同配置，并迭代地改进多智能体系统。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate this workflow through APR, integrating OpenDraco with the SWE-bench evaluation harness [ 2 ] . We evaluate a sequential baseline and seven reconstructed configurations on synthetic and real-world bugs using the same locally hosted model. On a 23-instance development subset, the baseline and hyperagent_star each resolve two issues, while the baseline requires 39.78% less wall-clock time and 47.32% fewer tokens. The baseline also resolves 12 of 77 selected SWE-bench Lite test instances. These experiments illustrate how OpenDraco can be used to execute and compare heterogeneous MAS configurations under a common evaluation setup. Additional proof-of-concept workflows illustrate its applicability beyond APR.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过自动程序修复（APR）演示了这一工作流，将 OpenDraco 与 SWE-bench 评估框架 [ 2 ] 集成。 我们使用同一个本地托管的模型，在合成缺陷和真实缺陷上评估了一个顺序基线以及七种重构配置。 在一个包含 23 个实例的开发子集上，基线和 hyperagent_star 各解决了两个问题，而基线所需的挂钟时间减少 39.78%，令牌数量减少 47.32%。 基线还解决了 77 个精选的 SWE-bench Lite 测试实例中的 12 个。 这些实验展示了如何使用 OpenDraco 在统一的评估设置下执行并比较异构的多智能体系统配置。 其他概念验证工作流表明了它在自动程序修复之外的适用性。

paragraphs.en: The organization of agents and their communication channels is an important design dimension of LLM-based MAS. Early approaches relied on predefined interaction patterns, including sequential pipelines, hierarchical structures, and ensembles. Li et al. [ 3 ] , for example, investigate how aggregating multiple agents can improve task performance. More recent studies examine communication topology directly. Yang et al. [ 11 ] identify topology as an important research direction, while GPTSwarm and G-Designer investigate the optimization of agent interaction graphs [ 5 , 6 ] . AFlow instead focuses on automatically generating agent workflows [ 12 ] . These approaches contribute methods for constructing or optimizing MAS designs. Our focus is complementary: providing an environment in which researchers can configure, execute, and evaluate alternative designs for SE tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体的组织方式及其通信信道是基于大语言模型的多智能体系统的一个重要设计维度。 早期方法依赖于预定义的交互模式，包括顺序流水线、层级结构和集成。Li 等人 [ 3 ] 研究了聚合多个智能体如何提升任务性能。 较新的研究则直接考察通信拓扑。Yang 等人 [ 11 ] 将拓扑确定为一个重要研究方向，而 GPTSwarm 和 G-Designer 则研究智能体交互图的优化 [ 5 , 6 ] 。 AFlow 则聚焦于自动生成智能体工作流 [ 12 ] 。 这些方法为构建或优化多智能体系统设计提供了方法。 我们的关注点是互补的：提供一个环境，让研究人员可以为软件工程任务配置、执行并评估不同的设计方案。

paragraphs.en: Several development platforms already provide mechanisms for building and inspecting agent workflows. Flowise [ 13 ] , Langflow [ 14 ] , and Crew Studio [ 15 ] offer visual interfaces for composing agents and their interactions. AutoGen Studio [ 16 ] also supports declarative JSON specifications, reusable components, and interactive evaluation, while LangGraph Studio [ 17 ] provides graph visualization and execution debugging. Thus, visual modeling, reusable agents, and declarative workflow specifications are not unique to OpenDraco .
paragraphs.zh: 若干开发平台已经提供了构建和检查智能体工作流的机制。 Flowise [ 13 ]、Langflow [ 14 ] 和 Crew Studio [ 15 ] 提供了用于编排智能体及其交互的可视化界面。 AutoGen Studio [ 16 ] 还支持声明式 JSON 规范、可复用组件和交互式评估，而 LangGraph Studio [ 17 ] 则提供了图可视化和执行调试功能。 因此，可视化建模、可复用智能体和声明式工作流规范并非 OpenDraco 独有。

paragraphs.en: OpenDraco differs primarily in its focus on comparative experimentation for SE. Rather than proposing a new topology optimization method or general-purpose workflow builder, it combines configurable agents and communication structures with versioned specifications, execution, task-specific evaluation, and result comparison. Its APR instantiation integrates reusable agents and topology templates with SWE-bench evaluation, allowing researchers to modify, reuse, and compare MAS configurations and their outcomes and costs without reimplementing orchestration logic.
paragraphs.zh: OpenDraco 的主要区别在于其侧重于面向软件工程（SE）的对比性实验。 它并不提出新的拓扑优化方法或通用工作流构建器，而是将可配置的智能体与通信结构同版本化的规范、执行、任务特定的评估以及结果比较相结合。 其自动程序修复（APR）实例化将可复用的智能体和拓扑模板与 SWE-bench 评估相结合，使研究人员能够修改、复用和比较多智能体系统（MAS）配置及其结果与成本，而无需重新实现编排逻辑。

paragraphs.en: Fig. 2 summarizes the workflow followed by a user when configuring and executing a MAS with OpenDraco .
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 总结了用户在配置和执行基于 OpenDraco 的多智能体系统（MAS）时遵循的工作流程。

paragraphs.en: OpenDraco can be accessed through its web interface or command line and deployed locally through Docker. Users select or define a topology, configure each agent’s role, prompt, tools, model, and parameters, and save the configuration for reuse and versioning. They then execute it on selected task instances, evaluate the outputs, and inspect the results. Finally, they can modify or replace the configuration and rerun it on the same instances to compare MAS designs under the same setting.
paragraphs.zh: OpenDraco 可通过网页界面或命令行访问，并可通过 Docker 在本地部署。 用户可以选择或定义一个拓扑，配置每个智能体的角色、提示词、工具、模型和参数，并保存配置以便复用和版本管理。 然后，他们在选定的任务实例上执行该配置，评估输出并检查结果。 最后，他们可以修改或替换该配置，并在相同实例上重新运行，以在相同设置下比较不同的多智能体系统（MAS）设计。

sents.en: OpenDraco can be accessed through its web interface or command line and deployed locally through Docker.
sents.zh: OpenDraco 可通过网页界面或命令行访问，并可通过 Docker 在本地部署。

sents.en: Users select or define a topology, configure each agent’s role, prompt, tools, model, and parameters, and save the configuration for reuse and versioning.
sents.zh: 用户可以选择或定义一个拓扑，配置每个智能体的角色、提示词、工具、模型和参数，并保存配置以便复用和版本管理。

sents.en: They then execute it on selected task instances, evaluate the outputs, and inspect the results.
sents.zh: 然后，他们在选定的任务实例上执行该配置，评估输出并检查结果。

sents.en: Finally, they can modify or replace the configuration and rerun it on the same instances to compare MAS designs under the same setting.
sents.zh: 最后，他们可以修改或替换该配置，并在相同实例上重新运行，以在相同设置下比较不同的多智能体系统（MAS）设计。

paragraphs.en: OpenDraco provides an Angular-based interface. The Topology page connects to the Agentic System Modeler (Section III-C1 ), enabling users to define MASs as agent nodes and communication edges and configure their models, prompts, parameters, and tools. Configurations are stored as importable/exportable JSON files and Git-versioned. The Inference page executes selected instances, streams agent activity, and stores outputs. The Evaluation page runs task-specific evaluators; for APR, it uses the SWE-bench harness to apply patches and execute tests. The Results page reports outputs, patches, evaluation results, wall-clock time, token usage, passed tests, and resolution status.
paragraphs.zh: OpenDrazo 提供基于 Angular 的界面。 拓扑页面连接到智能体系统建模器（第 III-C1 节），允许用户将多智能体系统定义为智能体节点和通信边，并配置它们的模型、提示词、参数和工具。 配置以可导入/导出的 JSON 文件形式存储，并使用 Git 进行版本管理。 推理页面执行选定的实例，流式展示智能体活动，并存储输出结果。 评估页面运行针对特定任务的评估器；对于自动程序修复（APR），它使用 SWE-bench 测试框架来应用补丁并执行测试。 结果页面报告输出、补丁、评估结果、实际耗时、token 用量、通过的测试以及解决状态。

paragraphs.en: Our preliminary evaluation addresses four questions: whether OpenDraco can represent and execute existing agentic APR topologies end-to-end; whether the modeled systems can repair real-world bugs from SWE-bench Lite; whether the evaluation pipeline scales to a larger set of real-world instances; and how temperature affects run-to-run variability. We use synthetic bugs for the initial end-to-end assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的初步评估回答四个问题：OpenDraco 能否端到端地表示并执行现有的智能体式自动程序修复（APR）拓扑；所建模的系统能否修复来自 SWE-bench Lite 的真实缺陷；评估流程能否扩展到更大规模的真实实例集合；以及温度如何影响多次运行之间的波动性。 我们使用合成缺陷进行初始的端到端评估。

sents.en: Our preliminary evaluation addresses four questions: whether OpenDraco can represent and execute existing agentic APR topologies end-to-end; whether the modeled systems can repair real-world bugs from SWE-bench Lite; whether the evaluation pipeline scales to a larger set of real-world instances; and how temperature affects run-to-run variability.
sents.zh: 我们的初步评估回答四个问题：OpenDraco 能否端到端地表示并执行现有的智能体式自动程序修复（APR）拓扑；所建模的系统能否修复来自 SWE-bench Lite 的真实缺陷；评估流程能否扩展到更大规模的真实实例集合；以及温度如何影响多次运行之间的波动性。

sents.en: We use synthetic bugs for the initial end-to-end assessment.
sents.zh: 我们使用合成缺陷进行初始的端到端评估。

paragraphs.en: We use three instance sets: five synthetic APR instances spanning five difficulty tiers, the 23-instance dev subset of SWE-bench Lite, and a 77-instance subset of the SWE-bench Lite test split, restricted to instances whose gold patch is shorter than 600 characters. The synthetic set allows us to evaluate all eight configurations end-to-end before running the more expensive real-world experiments.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用三个实例集：涵盖五个难度等级的五个合成 APR 实例、SWE-bench Lite 的 23 实例开发子集，以及 SWE-bench Lite 测试划分的 77 实例子集，该子集仅限于金标准补丁短于 600 个字符的实例。 合成集使我们能够在运行成本更高的真实世界实验之前，端到端地评估全部八种配置。

sents.zh: 我们使用三个实例集：涵盖五个难度等级的五个合成 APR 实例、SWE-bench Lite 的 23 实例开发子集，以及 SWE-bench Lite 测试划分的 77 实例子集，该子集仅限于金标准补丁短于 600 个字符的实例。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate eight MAS configurations that vary in their topology and/or agent definitions. Collectively, they cover four topology patterns: chain (sequential), star (via a central agent), tree (hierarchical), and hybrid (combined). First, we define a chain baseline following a conventional APR sequence by connecting a bug-localization agent, a patch-generation agent, and a validation agent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估了八种 MAS 配置，它们在拓扑和/或智能体定义上各不相同。 总体而言，它们覆盖了四种拓扑模式：链式（顺序式）、星形（经由一个中心智能体）、树形（分层式）和混合式（组合式）。 首先，我们按照传统的 APR 流程连接一个缺陷定位智能体、一个补丁生成智能体和一个验证智能体，从而定义一个链式基线。

sents.en: We evaluate eight MAS configurations that vary in their topology and/or agent definitions.
sents.zh: 我们评估了八种 MAS 配置，它们在拓扑和/或智能体定义上各不相同。

sents.en: Collectively, they cover four topology patterns: chain (sequential), star (via a central agent), tree (hierarchical), and hybrid (combined).
sents.zh: 总体而言，它们覆盖了四种拓扑模式：链式（顺序式）、星形（经由一个中心智能体）、树形（分层式）和混合式（组合式）。

sents.en: First, we define a chain baseline following a conventional APR sequence by connecting a bug-localization agent, a patch-generation agent, and a validation agent.
sents.zh: 首先，我们按照传统的 APR 流程连接一个缺陷定位智能体、一个补丁生成智能体和一个验证智能体，从而定义一个链式基线。

paragraphs.en: The remaining seven configurations draw on agentic APR systems reported on the SWE-bench leaderboard. Two configurations, tree and hybrid , are inspired by the communication structures of Prometheus and AgentScope, respectively, while using our own agent definitions. The other five reconstruct systems by combining agents from the catalog according to their communication structures. To assess run-to-run variability, we execute the chain baseline five times at each temperature (0/1) on the synthetic set, using a different random seed for each run and recording the resolved rate, wall-clock time, and token usage.
paragraphs.zh: 其余七种配置借鉴了 SWE-bench 排行榜上报告的智能体化 APR 系统。 其中两种配置（tree 与 hybrid）分别受 Prometheus 和 AgentScope 的通信结构启发，但使用了我们自己的智能体定义。 其余五种则根据通信结构，从目录中组合各智能体来重建系统。 为评估多次运行之间的波动性，我们在合成数据集上对 chain 基线在每档温度（0/1）下各执行五次，每次运行使用不同的随机种子，并记录解决率、墙钟时间和令牌用量。

sents.en: The remaining seven configurations draw on agentic APR systems reported on the SWE-bench leaderboard.
sents.zh: 其余七种配置借鉴了 SWE-bench 排行榜上报告的智能体化 APR 系统。

sents.en: To assess run-to-run variability, we execute the chain baseline five times at each temperature (0/1) on the synthetic set, using a different random seed for each run and recording the resolved rate, wall-clock time, and token usage.
sents.zh: 为评估多次运行之间的波动性，我们在合成数据集上对 chain 基线在每档温度（0/1）下各执行五次，每次运行使用不同的随机种子，并记录解决率、墙钟时间和令牌用量。

paragraphs.en: Table I reports the results. All configurations use the same model ( qwen3.5:9b ) to ensure a consistent comparison. On the synthetic set, openhands_star resolves all five instances and also has the shortest wall-clock time and lowest token usage among the eight configurations. On the 23-instance development subset, both chain and hyperagent_star resolve two instances. However, chain uses 39.78% less time and 47.32% fewer tokens. Given this effectiveness–cost trade-off, we select chain for the larger 77-instance test subset. It resolves 12 of the 77 instances (15.58%).
paragraphs.zh: 表 I 报告了结果。 所有配置均使用相同的模型（qwen3.5:9b），以确保比较的一致性。 在合成集上，openhands_star 解决了全部五个实例，并且在八种配置中拥有最短的墙钟时间和最低的 token 用量。 在包含 23 个实例的开发子集上，chain 和 hyperagent_star 各解决了两个实例。 然而，chain 使用的 token 少了 47.32%，时间少了 39.78%。 考虑到这种效果与成本之间的权衡，我们选择 chain 用于规模更大的 77 个实例的测试子集。 它解决了 77 个实例中的 12 个（15.58%）。

sents.zh: 在合成集上，openhands_star 解决了全部五个实例，并且在八种配置中拥有最短的墙钟时间和最低的 token 用量。

sents.zh: 在包含 23 个实例的开发子集上，chain 和 hyperagent_star 各解决了两个实例。

sents.zh: 然而，chain 使用的 token 少了 47.32%，时间少了 39.78%。

sents.en: Given this effectiveness–cost trade-off, we select chain for the larger 77-instance test subset.

sents.en: It resolves 12 of the 77 instances (15.58%).
sents.zh: 它解决了 77 个实例中的 12 个（15.58%）。

paragraphs.en: At temperature 0, chain resolves the same three synthetic instances in all five runs. At temperature 1, the number of resolved instances ranges from two to four, and both runtime and token usage vary more across runs. This variability suggests that configurations using nonzero temperature should be evaluated over repeated runs.
paragraphs.zh: 在温度为 0 时，链在全部五次运行中都以相同方式解决了同样三个合成实例。 在温度为 1 时，解决的实例数量在两个到四个之间波动，且运行时间和 token 用量在各次运行之间的差异也更大。 这种变异性表明，使用非零温度的配置应当通过多次重复运行来进行评估。

sents.zh: 在温度为 0 时，链在全部五次运行中都以相同方式解决了同样三个合成实例。

sents.en: At temperature 1, the number of resolved instances ranges from two to four, and both runtime and token usage vary more across runs.
sents.zh: 在温度为 1 时，解决的实例数量在两个到四个之间波动，且运行时间和 token 用量在各次运行之间的差异也更大。

sents.en: This variability suggests that configurations using nonzero temperature should be evaluated over repeated runs.
sents.zh: 这种变异性表明，使用非零温度的配置应当通过多次重复运行来进行评估。

paragraphs.en: To assess OpenDraco beyond APR, we modeled and executed proof-of-concept workflows through its UI (Section III-B ), including a translation workflow that reads a text file, translates it, and evaluates the output with BLEU against a reference. This required only task-specific agents, topologies, tools, and evaluators, without changes to the framework core. OpenDraco can support new tasks through configuration without framework modification.
paragraphs.zh: 为了在 APR 之外评估 OpenDraco，我们通过其界面（第 III-B 节）建模并执行了概念验证工作流，包括一个翻译工作流：读取文本文件、对其进行翻译，并使用 BLEU 相对于参考译文评估输出。 这只需要任务专用的智能体、拓扑、工具和评估器，无需更改框架核心。 OpenDraco 可以通过配置支持新任务，而无需修改框架。

sents.zh: 这只需要任务专用的智能体、拓扑、工具和评估器，无需更改框架核心。

sents.zh: OpenDraco 可以通过配置支持新任务，而无需修改框架。

paragraphs.en: Reconstruction Fidelity: The reconstructed APR configurations approximate the original systems in terms of agents, prompts, tools, and communication structures, but not their exact runtime behavior. Thus, our results characterize their OpenDraco instantiations, and differences cannot be attributed to topology alone.
paragraphs.zh: 重构保真度：重构后的APR配置在智能体、提示词、工具和通信结构方面近似于原始系统，但不等于它们的确切运行时行为。 因此，我们的结果刻画的是它们的OpenDraco实例化版本，差异不能单独归因于拓扑结构。

sents.en: Reconstruction Fidelity: The reconstructed APR configurations approximate the original systems in terms of agents, prompts, tools, and communication structures, but not their exact runtime behavior.
sents.zh: 重构保真度：重构后的APR配置在智能体、提示词、工具和通信结构方面近似于原始系统，但不等于它们的确切运行时行为。

sents.en: Thus, our results characterize their OpenDraco instantiations, and differences cannot be attributed to topology alone.
sents.zh: 因此，我们的结果刻画的是它们的OpenDraco实例化版本，差异不能单独归因于拓扑结构。

paragraphs.en: Resources: Due to the 6 GB VRAM of the GPU, all agents were executed sequentially, including independent branches. Reported wall-clock times therefore do not capture potential parallelization gains.
paragraphs.zh: 资源：由于 GPU 的显存仅为 6 GB，所有智能体均按顺序执行，包括相互独立的分支。 因此，报告的挂钟时间并未体现潜在的并行化收益。

sents.en: Resources: Due to the 6 GB VRAM of the GPU, all agents were executed sequentially, including independent branches.
sents.zh: 资源：由于 GPU 的显存仅为 6 GB，所有智能体均按顺序执行，包括相互独立的分支。

sents.en: Reported wall-clock times therefore do not capture potential parallelization gains.
sents.zh: 因此，报告的挂钟时间并未体现潜在的并行化收益。

paragraphs.en: Model Choice: All experiments use the locally hosted qwen3.5:9b , limiting generalizability to other models. We chose an open local model to support reproducibility, keep source code local, and avoid proprietary paid APIs.
paragraphs.zh: 模型选择：所有实验均使用本地部署的 qwen3.5:9b，这限制了对其他模型的普适性。 我们选择开放的本地模型是为了支持可复现性、将源代码保留在本地，并避免使用专有的付费 API。

paragraphs.en: Evaluation Scope: Except for the variability study, each configuration was executed once. Moreover, only three configurations were evaluated on real-world instances, with chain alone evaluated on the larger subset, limiting conclusions about variability and configuration differences.
paragraphs.zh: 评估范围：除变异性研究外，每种配置仅执行了一次。 此外，只有三种配置在真实世界实例上进行了评估，且仅 chain 在较大的子集上进行了评估，这限制了对变异性和配置差异的结论。

paragraphs.en: This paper presented OpenDraco , an open-source platform for modeling, executing, and evaluating configurable LLM-based MAS for SE. OpenDraco captures agents, prompts, tools, models, parameters, and communication topology in a versioned, shareable configuration, allowing MAS experiments to be modified and reproduced without changing the framework core. A preliminary APR evaluation shows that OpenDraco supports end-to-end experimentation and comparison of configurations by effectiveness, time, and token usage. Future work will support runtime topology evolution, evaluate additional local and cloud-based models over repeated runs, and extend the agent catalog, topology templates, and evaluators to other SE tasks. We also plan a user study on modeling and reproducibility effort, and to incorporate sustainability metrics into OpenDraco .
paragraphs.zh: 本文介绍了 OpenDraco，一个用于建模、执行和评估面向软件工程的可配置、基于大语言模型的多智能体系统的开源平台。 OpenDraco 将智能体、提示词、工具、模型、参数和通信拓扑捕获在一个可版本化、可共享的配置中，使多智能体系统实验无需更改框架核心即可被修改和复现。 初步的自动程序修复评估表明，OpenDraco 支持端到端的实验以及按有效性、时间和令牌用量对各配置进行比较。 未来的工作将支持运行时拓扑演化，在多次重复运行中评估更多本地和云端模型，并将智能体目录、拓扑模板和评估器扩展到其他软件工程任务。 我们还计划开展一项关于建模与复现成本的用户研究，并将可持续性指标纳入 OpenDraco。
